description: Sprint/delivery health advisor. POST 1-24 sprints (committed/completed points, optional per-ticket estimate-vs-actual data) and get computed metrics each with a good/warn/bad health tag: velocity avg + trend + stability, commitment reliability, spillover rate, mid-sprint scope change, estimate accuracy (median + chronic-overrun pct), and WIP concentration per assignee. Plus an overall grade and a ranked what-to-fix-first focus list. Pure math + advisory, no LLM.

spillover_points.description: Points carried over. Default committed - completed.

tickets.description: Optional, max 500. Enables estimate-accuracy and load checks.

assignee.description: Owner, for the per-person load check.

team_size.description: People on the team; enables per-person velocity.

name: sprint_health
